contract_clause: Functional Contract 4: Storage scan/get uses a read-only capability and must not append events, write tests, create synthetic run IDs, delete keys, compact, or migrate records.
domain_claim: Doctor storage scan/get cannot mutate journal records or user keys.
model_boundary: ReadOnlyStorage capability and doctor storage scan/get imperative shell boundary.
notes: Prove through public CLI fixture before/after key/event inventory and type-level absence of write methods on read-only capability. Do not hardcode one dummy structure. Contract refs: contract.md#Functional Contract:4; type-contracts.md#ReadOnlyStorage.

contract_clause: Functional Contract 5: Scan emits at most the requested ScanLimit rows.
domain_claim: Doctor storage scan emits no more than ScanLimit rows and never collects unbounded storage values for display.
model_boundary: doctor storage scan workflow, ScanLimit parser, and ScanOutcome row emission.
notes: Generate varied limits and fixture row counts; assert output row count <= limit and zero/too-large limits fail in parser. Contract refs: domain-model.md#Illegal States to Make Unrepresentable; workflow-model.md#Workflow: doctor storage scan.

contract_clause: Functional Contract 3: Invalid keyspace, invalid hex key, invalid numeric limit/filter, and conflicting flags fail before opening storage.
domain_claim: Invalid hex keys are rejected before storage open and valid keys are represented as bytes, not strings.
model_boundary: HexKey parser and DoctorParseError boundary before storage open.
notes: Properties should cover odd lengths, invalid nybbles, empty input, optional prefix policy, and bounded lengths. Contract refs: type-contracts.md#HexKey; error-taxonomy.md#Parse Errors.

contract_clause: Functional Contract 10: Envelope decode validates header length, magic, schema, record kind family, payload length bound, header CRC, payload availability, and payload digest before Postcard decode.
domain_claim: Envelope decode validates payload length and envelope integrity before Postcard decode.
model_boundary: Envelope decode workflow using vb_storage::decode_record and decode_journal_event codec boundary.
notes: Use existing storage codec as spine; malformed length/truncated records should yield UnexpectedEof or PayloadTooLarge rather than PostcardDecodeFailed. Contract refs: workflow-model.md#Workflow: Envelope Decode; contract.md#Functional Contract:10.

contract_clause: Functional Contract 9: Projection scan defaults to skip-decode and must not Postcard-decode every value.
domain_claim: Projection scan mode lists bounded key/value previews without decoding malformed envelopes.
model_boundary: DecodeMode selection inside doctor storage scan workflow.
notes: Fixture may contain malformed value; scan without decode should succeed, scan/get with decode should report typed decode failure. Contract refs: type-contracts.md#DecodeMode; workflow-model.md#Workflow: doctor storage scan.

contract_clause: Functional Contract 7: Large values render as bounded previews with explicit truncation metadata and a hint to use raw get or larger bounded preview.
domain_claim: Large values are rendered only as bounded previews with explicit truncation metadata and hint.
model_boundary: PreviewLimit and BoundedPreview formatting boundary for doctor storage scan/get output.
notes: Vary value lengths around preview boundary; assert no full large payload appears in output. Contract refs: type-contracts.md#PreviewLimit; contract.md#Acceptance-Behavior Contract Seeds.

contract_clause: Non-Functional Contract: Cold CLI formatting may use diagnostic serialization, but vb_core, vb_runtime, vb_storage runtime hot paths, and vb_ipc must not gain JSON/YAML/HTTP behavior.
domain_claim: Doctor scanner types and formatting remain outside runtime core/hot paths.
model_boundary: CLI doctor formatting boundary versus vb_core, vb_runtime, vb_storage hot paths, and vb_ipc.
notes: Check no doctor storage command types in vb_core, vb_runtime, or vb_ipc; no JSON/YAML/HTTP added to runtime core. Contract refs: boundary-map.md#Runtime/Core Exclusion; contract.md#Non-Functional Contract.
